title: DMRP Research Operations
objective: Materialise a federated GET/read-only Research Operations surface for canonical DMRP Path 1, Path 2 and ResearchCandidateGeneration owner records without constructing, repairing, ranking or merging scientific identities.
required_artifacts: GET-only API route and generated client
acceptance_conditions: One canonical DMRP ResearchCandidateGeneration constitution is preserved.
StructuralTermCandidate, P1CDI objects, C2P ObjectPack candidates and other owner-native candidates are not collapsed into ResearchCandidateGeneration.
Path 1 and Path 2 provenance remains distinct.
No Path winner meter, candidate ranking, candidate construction or candidate repair exists.
No first-new real DMRP Console presentation occurs without exact per-source admission.
GET/read-only and authority delta NONE are preserved.
rollback: Forward-disable/revert only WP5B1 Console bindings and restore the post-reconciliation pre-WP5B1 state; preserve DMRP owner records and history.
